Music

For as long as I can remember, I’ve loved music in all its forms. Both my parents raised me on a highly eclectic diet of sounds ranging from Pink Floyd to Buddha Bar, Elton John to Chopin, and I’ve digested it all into my own musical works along the way.

For as long as I can remember, I’ve loved music in all its forms. Both my parents raised me on a highly eclectic diet of sounds ranging from Pink Floyd to Buddha Bar, Elton John to Chopin, and I’ve digested it all into my own musical works along the way.

👉 I write & sing.

I’ve released under PocketFreud as well as Jérémy Chevallier.

Regardless, you can find it all on Soundcloud • Bandcamp • Spotify & other streaming services
